interpretive_limits: This is an ordinary state-gate and ongoing-simulation behavior, not a new technical mechanism or established artistic contribution.
No natural extinction, fuel exhaustion, removal of spectacle, real destruction, personal memory, or audience response was established.
The 20 s decoded-frame mismatch and viewport scroll are retained; no replacement extraction, re-recording or corrective artistic edit was made.
Simulation counts are discrete labels, not physical heat or material damage.
Engineering checks do not establish artistic contribution or acceptance.
decision: Preserve the untrimmed sampled recording and this negative rehearsal. Stop for the parent’s creative decision.
